description: Source code for the TranslatorGLSL class, part of the ANGLE project, responsible for translating shader code into GLSL. Contains methods for initializing built-in functions, writing GLSL version and extensions, and handling shader-specific code generation.

classes.name: TranslatorGLSL
classes.description: A class responsible for translating shader code into GLSL within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: TranslatorGLSL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TranslatorGLSL with shader type, specification, and output type.

methods.name: initBuiltInFunctionEmulator
methods.description: Initializes built-in function emulators based on compile options.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Performs the translation of the shader AST into GLSL code, handling version, extensions, pragmas, and shader-specific code.

methods.name: shouldFlattenPragmaStdglInvariantAll
methods.description: Determines if the stdgl invariant pragma should be flattened based on output type.

methods.name: shouldCollectVariables
methods.description: Decides whether to collect variables based on compile options.

methods.name: writeVersion
methods.description: Writes the GLSL version directive based on shader version.

methods.name: writeExtensionBehavior
methods.description: Writes GLSL extension directives based on extension behavior and shader type.

methods.name: conditionallyOutputInvariantDeclaration
methods.description: Outputs invariant declaration for a given varying if it is defined.
